text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Tamaki and {0} have arrived on the Marjan Coast
to join the celebrations for the start of beach season.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マルジェン海岸で催される海開きに参加するため、
タマキは{0}と共に海岸にやってきていた。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Look at this purr-fect weather!
Let's get started with the preparations!
choice_data_list: Need any help putting on sunscreen?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい天気でよかったにゃ～！
　
さっそく準備を始めるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: You knyow it! Gotta get warmed up when you come to the beach!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう、
海へ来たらしっかり準備運動を……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Sure, I'll let you stroke my back...
text_block_list.orig_text: それじゃあ背中を頼むにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, nyo! We didn't come here to play around!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って違うにゃ！
　ここへは遊びに来たわけじゃないにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
It's nyot the beach season without delicious snyacks for sale!
I'm here to set up my taiyaki stand by the sea!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海開きと言ったら、
当然浜辺に屋台は付き物にゃ！
あたしの目的はそこにたい焼き屋台を出すことにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I'll get the beachgoers purring with my tasty treats,
and make a purr-fect profit while I'm at it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいしいたい焼きをお客に売って売って売りさばいて、
夏はがっぽり稼ぎまくりにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
If I sell enough, I'll treat you to some nyice fat taiyaki
too, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっぱい売れたら
{0}にも
おいしいたい焼きをごちそうするにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: So lend me a paw while I set things up, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
準備の手伝いしっかり頼むにゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? The director of the event is saying something.
It's nyot time for things to kick off yet... Is something up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　海開きの主催者がなにか言ってるにゃ。
イベント開始にはまだ時間があるし、
何か事件かにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Hold the preparations for the beach event!
Something terrible has happened!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海開きの準備をしている皆さん！
　大変なことが起きました！

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
The net for our beach volleyball tournament
has been missing since this morning!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビーチバレー大会で使用するネットが、
今朝からどこにも見当たりません！

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
There were signs of disturbance around where it was stored,
so it seems it must have been stolen!
text_block_list.orig_text:
置いてあった場所が荒らされていたことから、
何者かに盗まれたようです！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Myehhh?! Who would steal a thing like that...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～っ！？
　なんでそんなものが盗まれるにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
In past years, this tournament has been enormously popular.
It was set to be the very centerpiece of our celebrations!
text_block_list.orig_text:
例年、
ビーチバレー大会はとても盛り上がり、
海開きの目玉イベントと言っても過言ではありません。

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: At this rate, we may have to cancel the whole event...
text_block_list.orig_text:
このままでは
イベントを中止せざるを得ません……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's nyot good at all!
I've invested a lot of time and money in this venture!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それは困るにゃ！
　この日のために準備だってしてきたのに！

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! For the sake of everyone who was looking forward
to the event, I beg of you all, help me to recover our lost volleyball net!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その通りです！
　このイベントを楽しみにしてくれる人たちのため、
どうか皆さん、
盗まれたネットを見つけ出してきてください！

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
To whomsoever recovers the net before the start of the event,
I promise a handsome reward!
text_block_list.orig_text:
イベント開始時間までに見つけ出してくださった方には、
謝礼も
お支払いいたします！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
A-a reward?! This sounds like a profit opportunity!
Let's you and me together sniff out the culprit and get that net!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しゃ、
謝礼！？
　
これはひと稼ぎできるチャンスにゃ！
あたし達二人で、
犯人を見つけてネットを取り返すにゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
First of all, let's ask around here for information!
C'mon, there's gotta be useful intel to be found!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは、
この辺りにいる人たちに聞き込みにゃ～
さぁ、
有益な情報を手に入れてくるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Of everything we found, I think the likeliest lead we heard about
is that local gang of hoodlums.
text_block_list.orig_text:
集めた情報の中で、
一番怪しかったと思うのは、
地元の有名なゴロツキにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I bet they're a bunch of knyuckleheads who stole the net on a dare
to prove their machismo or something!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きっとネットを盗んで、
それをくだらない夏の武勇伝として語る、
どうしようもないアホな連中にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian
text_block_list.text: Eh? The hell'd you just say, girlie?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ？
　なんか言ったかてめぇ！？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... What an aggressive-looking guy...
Is this one of the hoodlums we heard about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ……
いかにもガラの悪い見た目……
もしかして地元のゴロツキかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Ruffian
text_block_list.text:
Who you callin' a hoodlum?! Eh?!
An outsider like you, actin' like such a big shot!
I'll kick your ass out of our town!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰がゴロツキだ！
　あ？
地元民でもねぇくせにデケェ面しやがって！
今すぐ追い出してやんよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What're you starin' at, scrawny dude?!
I'm talkin' to the girlie! Move it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい！
　おめぇも何ガンくれてんだよ！
そっちの女に用あんだよ、
どけっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Are you OK?!
Hey, hoodlum! What did this guy do to deserve that?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
大丈夫かにゃ！？
おいゴロツキ！
　なんでこの人まで突き飛ばすにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you've done it now! I'm gonna string you up good,
then find out what you knyow about the net!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう許さないにゃ！
　こいつを捻り上げたあと、
ネットを盗んだか聞き出してやるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myah! Myamyah!
Get too cocky and you'll feel my claws!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃっ！
　にゃっ、にゃっ！
調子こくと痛い目見るにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian
text_block_list.text: Th-this girl... She's tough!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
この女
強ぇ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: You're nyot getting away!
text_block_list.orig_text: まだ逃がさないにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian
text_block_list.text:
Guehh...! I-I'm sorry, all right?! You win this round!
So please, quit tryin' to twist my arm off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐえぇっ……！
　わ、
悪かった……！
　俺の負けだ！
だから腕を捻るのはやめてくれーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Before I do, answer me something.
This morning, did you steal the beach volleyball net?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その前に、聞きたいことがあるにゃ。
今朝、
ビーチバレー大会のネットを盗んだにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Ruffian
text_block_list.text:
I-I ain't been stealin' no net!
I bet that's the work of the monster
that's been showing up near the coast lately!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
俺はそんなことしてねぇよ！
最近海岸に現れるようになった
魔物のせいかもしれねぇ！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian
text_block_list.text:
After all, I saw it crawling around the coast
on the morning when the net went missing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
実際、
ネットが盗まれたっていう朝に、
魔物が
海岸を歩いてるのを見たんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Really...? Is that the truth? You're nyot making it up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それ……
本当の話にゃ？
　嘘ついてないにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Ruffian
text_block_list.text: I swear I wouldn't lie to you! So please, lemme go already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
嘘なんてついてねぇよ！
　だから
腕を離してくれーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I'm nyot sure whether to trust this guy...
But I guess it's worth a try.
text_block_list.orig_text:
イマイチ信じきれないけど……
まぁ、調べてみるにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
If there really was a monster...
the question is where it's gone nyow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もし魔物がいたとして……
今どこにいるかが問題にゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
My instincts tell me with all these crowds gathering,
it'd probably try to hide itself during the day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしとしては、
朝より人が多くなってきたし、
魔物も警戒してどこかに隠れると思うにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh—what about the tall grass nyear here?
A monster could hide pretty well there!
Let's go take a peek!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
この近くの草場なら、
魔物が隠れられるんじゃにゃいか！？
さっそく探してみるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myurghh... There's so much tall grass, just searching
through it's an ordeal... Oh, {0}!
Look over there—is that the volleyball net we're after?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅぅ～
草場も思ったより広くて
探すのが大変にゃ……
あ、{0}！
あそこにあるの、
ビーチバレーのネットじゃないかにゃ！？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
What's it doing out in a place like this...?
It's so scrunched up, it'll be a pain to untangle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃんのためにこんなところにネットを……
くしゃくしゃに絡まっててほどくのも一苦労にゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Do you think the monster
rolled up the net to use it as a nest...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！
　もしかしてこれ、
魔物がネットを丸めて巣にしてたんじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAGGHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Myaaahhh?! Looks like the nest's owner just got home!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃあぁっ！？
　ホントに魔物が帰ってきたにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
But this net isn't for building nests, you knyow! We're taking it back!
Myah! Myamyah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このネットはお前の巣に使うモノじゃないにゃ！
　返してもらうにゃ！
にゃっ！
　にゃっ、にゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GREEOOOUGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Whew... Good thing it wasn't a strong monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
弱い魔物で助かったにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! What time is it nyow?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁっ！
　今何時にゃ！？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for the event to start!
We've gotta untangle this net, and get it back to its owner!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうすぐ海開きの時間にゃ！
急いでネットをほどいて、
早く渡しにいくにゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
Th-they've started the opening ceremony! Hold on a minute!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……はぁ……
か、
開会式が始まってるにゃ！
　ちょっと待つにゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Could that be the stolen net you're holding?!
You really tracked it down for us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　
その手に持っているのはネットではありませんか！
本当に見つけて来てくれたのですね！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: All right! Now we can hold the tournament!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったわ！
　これで大会が行える！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... The beach season celebrations are saved!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった！
　安心して海開きができるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Myahh... All this applause makes my fur stand on end! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃあ……
拍手されると、
ちょっと照れるにゃ～♪

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: {0}, thanks for helping me search!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、一緒に探してくれて
ありがとにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the applause, Tamaki and {0}
turned to one another and laughed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
タマキと{0}は、拍手に包まれながら、
互いの顔を見合わせて笑いあった。
